title: When received mercy opens the hand
subtitle: For the heart learning to release because it has been received
description: These readings move from mercy received to forgiveness given, without letting the gift become sentiment only.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The mercy that gathers the wandering heart teaches the hand how to unclench toward others.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Forgive from received mercy, not from pressure to look generous.

evidence.coreClaim: This path makes forgiveness the outward shape of mercy received inwardly.
evidence.turn: The hand opens more honestly when it remembers how much mercy has already opened toward it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Release one claim to repayment because you have not lived by repayment alone.
